content_of_post_to_comment:
Today after a long day at work, I wanted to go for a walk without my phone. Just no distractions, not even a presence of my phone or other digital devices.

I noticed this today. I am actually scared to leave it at home, what if my mom calls, or my friends and I don’t answer. Will they get worried?

Has anyone else experienced this, it’s a little tough to admit but it’s very real for me.
comment: I had a similar feeling when I first started leaving my phone behind. I realized I wasn’t just worried about missing calls, I was carrying the responsibility of being instantly available all the time. It helped to remind family that I’d be unreachable for a bit and set a simple expectation. Being unavailable for a walk doesn’t mean you’re ignoring people.
